subject: Temporary node escrow ask for Lumen Dynamics — sizing & provisional hold
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Heads-up: Lumen Dynamics late-stage sizing request

Team — quick heads-up. Lumen Dynamics is moving toward final exec sign-off this month for a Dedicated deployment. Sales Intl (Sam) just told me they expect a November go-live window and want us to hold capacity while procurement finishes PO/contract redlines.

Ask: can infra perform a tentative sizing + availability check and put a soft hold on the nodes required for ~60 days? We should avoid committing long-term until PO arrives but reserve a safety net to prevent losing the runway.

What I know so far (from Sam):
- Expected models: two medium-large LLMs (approx. 25B each) with KV cache usage.
- Anticipated initial concurrency: 60 RPS token-level peak, steady-state 15 RPS.
- Prefer US West region, tolerance for cross-az redundancy.

Marissa — please add the deal to HubSpot record and open a capacity ticket if we can provision a soft-reserve.
Rishi/Jonas — can you run a quick fleet fit (H100-equivalent mapping + thermal affinity) and advise node count and recommended hold terms?

I attached a one-line note Sam sent earlier. I can follow up to get any missing numbers. Thanks — Irne

--
Irene Choi
Head of Dedicated Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@lumendyn.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Heads-up: Lumen Dynamics late-stage sizing request

Thanks, Irene — I added LD-2026-089 to HubSpot (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/LD-2026-089) and attached a quick availability snapshot from tonight's inventory run (gpu-availability-snapshot-20260918.csv).

Initial ops read (preliminary):
- Total H100-equivalent capacity free in US-west pool this quarter: ~42 nodes.
- Minimum thermal slices limiting contiguous placement in a single AZ: 12 nodes.
- We have short windows of DR maintenance planned 2026-10-10->2026-10-12 in us-west-2, so a soft hold is safer than straight single-AZ pin.

I'll open ticket C-9876 to request a provisional hold (soft-reserve) for the node set you confirm. I'll flag procurement contact once you (Rishi) confirm nominal count.

Attachment: gpu-availability-snapshot-20260918.csv (columns: datacenter, sku_equiv, available_nodes, maintenance_windows)

--
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Heads-up: Lumen Dynamics late-stage sizing request

Irene/Marissa — ran a quick capacity mapping. Based on Sam's initial traffic and model footprint (~25B x2, medium KV cache), our conservative estimate:

- Performance target: p95 latency < 120ms at 60 RPS peak token throughput.
- Recommended minimum: 8 H100-equivalent nodes (distributed as 5+3 across two racks/azs) for redundancy.
- Preferred buffer (60-day soft-hold): +2 nodes (safety headroom) => propose soft-reserve = 10 nodes.

Notes / constraints:
- Thermal affinity: 6 of those nodes should be colocated in the low-latency rack; remaining spread for fallback.
- If they want single-AZ low-latency, we can attempt 8 contiguous nodes, but that eats into our contiguous pool and risks maintenance impacts (per Marissa's note).
- Quantization/packing tradeoff: if we run q4_0 and aggressive batch tuning, we can probably meet targets with 7 nodes, but quality risk — not recommended pre-contract.

Operational action: open soft-reserve ticket (C-9876), expiry 60 days from hold start unless PO arrives / contract executed. I can approve the hold policy on the ticket if we confirm the node count.

Request for Sales: please get final expected steady-state and 95th token-per-second estimate from Sam (they gave broad numbers; we need token RPS per model + expected top-k sampling to finalize sizing). Also confirm if they require dedicated NVMe for local cache.

I'll draft a short MOU that states provisional hold terms and expiry. Putting a copy in the thread after I have procurement timeline.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Infrastructure Lead, Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@lumendyn.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumendyn.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T11:08:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Temporary node escrow ask for Lumen Dynamics — sizing & provisional hold

Hi Irene / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and for pulling ops into the loop. A few clarifications from our side:

- Goal is to hit Nov 15 production launch; procurement timelines are tight but we expect a signed PO by mid-October.
- We're okay with a 60-day provisional hold as long as the hold is cancellable with 30 days notice from either side.
- Preferred config: H100-equivalent nodes, 8 nodes as baseline. If you recommend a 10-node hold for buffer, we can accept that as long as pricing for the buffer is clarified in the MOU.
- Cache: yes — we plan to use local NVMe for model shards; will provide exact size in follow-up and loop procurement.

Next: please send a short MOU/hold confirmation so we can align legal/procurement. Happy to sign an MOU to reserve the nodes while final T&Cs are negotiated.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Product
Lumen Dynamics
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@lumendyn.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary node escrow ask for Lumen Dynamics — sizing & provisional hold

Thanks all — plan below:

1) Confirm node count: we'll propose a 10-node soft-reserve (H100-equivalent) with a 60-day expiry and 30-day mutual cancellable clause to match Sam's ask. (Rishi to sign off on ticket C-9876.)
2) Marissa to open/track the soft-reserve ticket and attach the availability snapshot (C-9876).
3) Rishi to draft a one-page MOU outlining hold terms, buffer pricing (if buffer used), and expiry. Rishi will attach lumendyn-mou-draft-20260919.pdf to the ticket and to this thread when ready.
4) Marissa/Irene will loop procurement once the MOU is attached to the ticket; Sam is copied for alignment.

Action owners: Marissa — open ticket and set expiry timer. Rishi — MOU draft & infra sign-off. Irene — follow up with Sam mid-week to confirm PO ETA.

If no objections, I'll proceed to confirm the soft-reserve window with ops via the ticket.

--
Irene Choi
Head of Dedicated Sales
Redwood Inference
